events.title: BURNTCRUST Demo Launch
events.summary: The time has come! The demo for BURNTCRUST is now live! Will be keeping an eye on any issues and bugs, as this is my first attempt at a live access product. Feel free to join the discord to report anything or give feedback. Hope to see you in space soon!

events.title: Attention Playtesters!
events.summary: BURNTCRUST's first playtest is almost ready! Make sure to request access on the store page if you haven't yet, and join the discord to get more info about the starting time, as well as the game's overall progress. This early playtest will be for testing bugs, general gameplay feel and direction, and to understand the player expectations as well as any major mistakes to avoid / fix before the final release.
